revision: D7 - slide-in fan grilles, printed hardware and resettable plug holder
fan_depth_datum: Suction face remains at fan-local Z=30; fan_center_y/z retain the original pose anchor at local Z=22.5. Added thickness grows outward; the actual 25 mm fan center is 5 mm outward from this anchor.
notes: D6 re-extracts all three USB-C centers from the source mesh, preserving handedness. Port types follow Dell owner manual. Source visualization dimensions require physical calibration; no reflection is used to orient the laptop.

coordinate_frame.x: Positive from keyboard-left/plug end (x=0) toward keyboard-right end (x=353.68). Plug appears screen-right in a lid-facing view.
coordinate_frame.y: Positive toward lid/user/fans; negative toward underside/intake.
coordinate_frame.z: Positive upward from original D6 desk datum; D7 adhesive panel feet extend to z=-2.5 mm.
coordinate_frame.construction: Preserve Dell source handedness; translation then rigid lean, no reflection. Positive depth_adjustment inserts plug along +X; laptop docks along -X.

contact_scheme: Profiled hinge-end seats carry weight; laptop leans on plenum-wall liners. A continuous low underside lip restrains thrust and aids alignment, split only at the shell joint. Rubber feet and intake remain clear.
cassette_adjustment: Replaceable keyed shim encodes measured height, depth and lateral calibration. One printed8x2 hand screw and keeper plate clamp it to the folding carrier. Independent printed10x2 chassis stop remains fixed.

breakaway.qualification: Printed calibration prototype: static nominal target, not verified force or impact ceiling.
